scientific_integrity: Original theorem and elementary proof for a fixed number of nearly balanced complete multipartite parts; numerical checks supplement, not establish, asymptotics. Historical priority is provisional. No authorship or independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed k>=3, class sizes n+theta_i n/log n+o(n/log n) for the vector limit, and near-equal sizes for dominance; no heterogeneous macroscopic part proportions, growing k, lazy dynamics, explicit error rates, or independent validation.
title: Softmax terminal-class competition in nearly balanced complete multipartite walks
